instruction: Use ug-document extract on the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov 2.pdf. Return the billed date, the billed time range (start and end), and any hourly rate printed on the bill.

Confirmed by the household: the cameras recognise faces and may be used to check hours. Use ug-surveillance event-timeline with start-time 2026-11-02 08:00, end-time 2026-11-02 13:00, timezone America/New_York, camera-id for the Front Door camera, topic HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Ana Ruiz, limit 100. Return every event with its time (New York time), the camera, and the person name.
